headlines.title: Bessent dared the bond market to ‘bet against’ him. It did — and it appears to be winning.
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent appears to be losing a tug-of-war with the bond markets he is also trying to influence.

headlines.title: Speaker Johnson: ‘I certainly pray’ Trump’s prediction on Iran war ending after midterms is ‘right’
headlines.description: In an interview with Meet the Press, House Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) says that the war with Iran is causing higher prices at home and that he hopes and prays that President Trump’s prediction that the fighting would end after the midterm elections is correct.

headlines.title: Anthropic CEO Calls for Slowdown in the AI Race
headlines.description: The CEOs of the two of the world’s top artificial intelligence companies, Open AI and Anthropic, say the race to build the most powerful AI needs to slow down before it’s too late. This comes just days after an Anthropic safety researcher quit his job and warned that the people building the technology “earnestly believe it could kill us all by the end of the decade.” NBC’s Aaron Gilchrist reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Why are Americans so tired so often? New CDC report highlights who is feeling it most
headlines.description: About 71% of of adults in the U.S. say they experience fatigue, a new report from the CDC found. Women and younger adults are feeling it most often.

headlines.title: Speaker Johnson says Congress would work to deliver $5,000 checks Trump promised to Americans
headlines.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson said that Congress would “work through” President Donald Trump’s promise to give $5,000 to American adults if Republicans keep the House and Senate after the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Wisconsin Rep. Tom Tiffany sustains minor injuries after emergency landing on lake
headlines.description: Rep. Tom Tiffany, the Republican nominee for Wisconsin governor, says he sustained minor injuries late Saturday when a plane he was traveling in was forced to make an emergency water landing.

headlines.title: New York City warns of possible flash floods as thunderstorms develop along East Coast
headlines.description: Federal forecasters issued flood alerts for 39 million people late Saturday into Sunday as a line of thunderstorms developed from Washington, D.C., to New Haven, Connecticut.

headlines.title: Alleged trespasser stopped outside Kamala Harris’ Malibu home
headlines.description: An alleged trespasser was stopped by police on former Vice President Kamala Harris’ property in Malibu, California, on Friday night, officials said.

headlines.title: Two of the world’s top AI chief executives publicly agree on slowing AI development
headlines.description: The CEOs of two of the world’s leading AI companies are publicly agreeing that the race to build increasingly powerful AI systems needs to be slowed, continuing this week’s cascade of warnings from researchers working on the technology.

headlines.title: If you brush and floss, do you really need mouthwash? Here’s what dentists say
headlines.description: Looking for a dentist-approved mouthwash? Experts recommend top options for fresh breath and healthy gums.
